podcast.title: Italian and German Hub
podcast.body: Primarily headquartered in Italy and Germany, this scene significantly influenced late 1980s British pop artists such as Rick Astley and Kylie Minogue. "Another offshoot was Euro Disco, which was headquartered mostly in Italy and Germany. That scene later influenced a lot of late 80s British pop like Rick Astley and Connie Menog."
